info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Current Account Information API
info.description: The Current Account Information API provides access to detailed information regarding customers' current accounts within the banking system. This API allows authorized users to retrieve account balances, transaction history, and other relevant data essential for account management. Typical consumers include banking applications, financial institutions, and customer service platforms needing to deliver accurate account details to users or clients. This endpoint facilitates efficient banking operations by providing real-time insights into account activities and statuses.

get.summary: Retrieve current account details for deposit lending.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the detailed information about a current account in the context of deposit lending. It provides insights into account balances, transaction history, and other pertinent account-related data, facilitating informed decision-making for users engaged in financial activities.
